mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST rises by at least 1.0% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals an imminent monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in employment (PAYEMS) signal a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases, as measured by a negative Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 98.0 during a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates increasing price pressures, which typically prompts central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 850.0 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 850.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth of GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 5.0%), a low unemployment rate signals strong labor conditions, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0% during a high labor market tightness regime.
